messages:
maya_pm: Quick alignment thread for the tool-calling + structured-output rollout. Need a clear launch checklist (docs, SDKs, runtime, partner comms) and owners. Keeping it tight so we can commit at next roadmap freeze.
dan_ts: From TS side: we need a typings compatibility shim and a migration lint rule. Plan: add `tool_calling` export and keep `function_call` alias for one semver-major window.
anna_py: Python will mirror: add `client.tool_call` as first-class, keep `client.function_call` as alias with deprecation warning. Also add a deprecation warning log when alias used.
ren_docs: Docs ask: a single canonical example per language, plus a migration guide with copy-paste snippets. Also need a short "what changed" notice on the frontpage.
taylor_devex: I'll create the changelog template. Suggested fields: affected endpoints, SDK impact, migration steps (1-2 code snippets), deprecation timeline, tests to add.
sasha_runtime: Runtime constraints: we can normalize `function_call` -> `tool_calling` in the router and return `X-Deprecation: function_call; removal=2026-07-01` header. We should also expose a runtime flag to enable strict JSON schema validation per-org.
maya_pm: Nice. Let's record concrete gating criteria for launch. I propose: (A) SDKs published with alias and unit tests, (B) docs updated with canonical examples + migration guide, (C) runtime mapping + header in prod, (D) partner comms sent and legal sign-off for healthcare partner, (E) CI checks (typings + lint) green. Any objections?
dan_ts: No objections. I'll own (A) for TS. ETA: PR + draft changelog by Wed.
anna_py: I'll own Python (A). ETA: Thurs.
ren_docs: I'll own docs (B). ETA: Thurs COB; will wait for TS types to sync.
taylor_devex: I'll own changelog + CI gating (E). I'll add a GH Action that fails on missing migration snippet.
sasha_runtime: I'll own runtime rollout (C). ETA: Tue EOD for staging, prod by Fri if tests pass.
maya_pm: Partner comms (D) — I will draft and @legal in parallel. ETA: Wed AM.
dan_ts: Implementation detail: TS `tsc` strict mode flagged a type union conflict. Plan: export `type ToolCall = { name: string; args?: Record<string, unknown> | null; outputs?: unknown[] }` and `export const function_call = tool_calling as any; // shim` with console.warn. Will add deprecation typedef in index.d.ts.
anna_py: Python snippet we'll add to docs:
```py
# new canonical usage
resp = client.tool_call("search", {"q": "diabetes trials"})
# legacy alias still works but logs a DeprecationWarning
resp = client.function_call("search", {"q": "diabetes trials"})
```
ren_docs: Docs note: include an example showing `structured_output.metadata` standardized shape: `{\n  "source": "string",\n  "score": float,\n  "schema_version": "v1"\n}` and explain recommended keys.
taylor_devex: Changelog template: `- change: string; - impact: [python, typescript, runtime]; - migration: steps; - deprecation_date: YYYY-MM-DD; - tests: list`. I'll add a small checklist that must be filled before merge.
sasha_runtime: One open question: do we enforce schema validation server-side by default? Ops says default off; we provide `org.schema_validation = true` toggle. We'll document expected behavior.
maya_pm: Decision: default validation = off; opt-in per-org. Deprecation header until 2 major releases after v2 rollout. SDKs will log a deprecation warning for one release, then remove alias.
dan_ts: Tests: I'll add typings tests (dtslint or tsd) showing both names compile. Also add an integration e2e that confirms server deprecation header present when `function_call` used.
anna_py: Python tests: unit tests for alias + integration test asserting `DeprecationWarning` captured.
ren_docs: Also add a cross-ref section for embeddings/rerank: standardize `structured_output.metadata` across these endpoints so examples are consistent.	aylor_devex: Deployment checklist (short):
1) runtime normalization PR merged and staged
2) TS + Py PRs merged, packages published to canary
3) docs PR merged + redirect notice live
4) changelog entry created + release-notes draft
5) partners emailed + legal cleared
6) monitor metrics for errors for 48h after rollout
I'll own gating check before cut.
release-bot: release/cut status: no blocking PRs detected for project "tool-calling".
maya_pm: Great. I'll run retrospective if anything slips. Marking owners: Dan (TS), Anna (Py), Ren (docs), Taylor (devex/changelog & CI), Sasha (runtime), Maya (partner/legal/launch).
dan_ts: I'll open the initial TS PR now and tag reviewers.
anna_py: Starting py branch.
ren_docs: I'll draft the canonical examples page and leave TODO spots for code snippets pending PRs.
maya_pm: Thanks team. We'll reconvene Friday morning for final sign-off. :rocket:
